description: REC-CBM is a research dataset release that adds rubric-aligned, expert-validated concept annotations to the Mohler, ASAP 2.0, and MOCHA open-ended response-grading benchmarks for interpretable automated grading research.
title: Rubric-aligned concept-annotated grading benchmarks (REC-CBM)

description: RULER is a social-emotional learning programme developed and run by the Yale Center for Emotional Intelligence that teaches recognizing, understanding, labeling, expressing, and regulating emotions.
title: RULER

description: RMEP is a rural Virginia education partnership programme that coordinates families, teachers, and communities through mathematics guidance, professional development, family events, STEM activities, technology access, and online resources to prepare students for advanced STEM study.
title: Rural Math Excel Partnership (RMEP)
